about: Seed calibration corpus for the Glowby scam-risk engine. Written from the FTC, FBI IC3 and WSJ descriptions of common scam shapes (Sept 2026) plus ordinary legitimate messages. Synthetic — no real victim's text. Every case carries an answer key (expected verdict bands, required red-flag codes) and a split; this file is the DEV split only — validation and hidden cases live in the database, never in the repo.
